title: the db client finds the box's passfile from a scratch-HOME child
intention: A child run under a scratch HOME still reaches the box's Postgres on the TCP route: the client finds the box's pgpass through the box root home_env names, and never through the scratch.
why: Measured 2026-11-13 by akiendell on the Windows house checkout at d2a61adc9: with d95796cdfb9b's home_env setting USERPROFILE beside HOME, codemother/machines/clearance/proofs/test_clearance.py reds at its first scratch-HOME ask (:103) with '5432 fe_sendauth: no password supplied'; with only that line reverted it is green. store._conn_args on Windows dials TCP loopback with passfile= the pgpass under the instance root, falling back to the root the process started with (fc4bb2062253). In a scratch-HOME child both are the scratch, so no pgpass is found, and the explicit passfile= overrides libpq's own PGPASSFILE, so nothing outside store.py can supply it.
traces_to: fc4bb2062253 (the passfile survives a repointed instance root); d95796cdfb9b (a scratch HOME is the child's home on Windows too); Law 3.
how: D1 _conn_args falls back, after its own root and its startup root, to the pgpass under CAIRN_SCRATCH_BOX_INSTANCE. D2 a tooth in the passfile proof.

clauses.claim: with no pgpass under the current or startup root, _conn_args names none while CAIRN_SCRATCH_BOX_INSTANCE is unset, names the box's once it is set, and the current root's pgpass still wins

decisions.text: D1: store._conn_args tries, in order, the current root's pgpass, the startup root's, then <CAIRN_SCRATCH_BOX_INSTANCE>/devices/db_domain/0/pgpass; the variable is read as a string.
D2: tooth test_a_scratch_home_child_finds_the_box_passfile in the passfile proof.

measured.what: test_clearance.py on Windows with home_env's USERPROFILE
measured.saw: red at :103, 5432 fe_sendauth: no password supplied; green with the line reverted
measured.how: akiendell, Windows house checkout at d2a61adc9, three runs (relayed by the orchestrator)

measured.saw: 3/3 green; with store.py reverted the new tooth fails
